description: Fork of exp104 (TinyMultiHeadLut sparse_scatter mode) reducing nap from 8 to 6 (table_dim 256 -> 64, 4x smaller per-table weights) while doubling tph for qk/v (384 -> 768) and out_proj (2048 -> 4096). Net per-table weight is halved across all three LUT modules; table count grows 2x for qk/v and 2x for out_proj. Goal: more tables for input pair coverage with smaller per-table weights, taking advantage of the Tiny sparse_scatter path. Other settings (E=384, d_qk=32, d_v=64, classic skip, linear unembedder, all sparse_scatter_n_outputs=8) unchanged from exp104.
